workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly two same-date source-complete Reading Notes and produced two bounded Research Objects. Q-20260917-01 concludes that replay eligibility is a fresh execution-time fact: historical success should persist as provenance and reusable capability evidence, while current environment state, target binding and declared parameter contracts must re-qualify the procedure for each run; replay admission must remain separate from business authorization and external-effect verification.
